Embedded module: buffer (the browser Buffer shim)

Primary source:
  https://github.com/feross/buffer
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/feross/buffer/master/LICENSE

The published ag-psd 29.0.0 browser artifact contains the module header
"The buffer module from node.js, for the browser", author Feross Aboukhadijeh,
and an MIT marker.  The artifact does not retain the npm package metadata or
commit for this embedded copy.  Its embedded buffer version is therefore
unknown and is not asserted here.  This is a notice for the code actually
present in ag-psd/dist/bundle.js, not a claim that it is the current upstream
release.
